title: The workshop.
logline: The quokka makes things that aren't notes, and they stay ordinary files.

story.setup: The quokka needs a map of the island and a letter for the ferry office.
story.turn: It sketches the map on an Excalidraw board and writes the letter in a Word document, right beside its notes.
story.payoff: Both are saved in their own formats, as the same ordinary files any other app reads.

features.claim: Word documents (.docx) and Excalidraw boards open and save in their own formats, alongside your notes.
Sketch on an Excalidraw canvas saved as an ordinary .excalidraw file.
